sources.observation: The red-painted deck uses crossed panels, a shallow suspension curve and a rounded brace at the tower head.
The four tapered lattice shafts, spread footings, shore stays and suspended car read across the river.
The gondola has continuous white passenger cabins on each side, glazing and a central loading lane carried by crossed wires.

limitations: The bridge operator's technical profile supplies the 61 m tower height and the 45 m high-water clearance. The water fixture uses one static datum and the anchorage grades use available raster samples.
The gondola is drawn at a fixed point in the crossing. Cable attachments and fine fittings are approximate.
